summary: GG2026 Phase 4 SERP Intelligence Integration - ALL 14 backend tests PASS. Provider abstraction layer with 3 providers (Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO) verified. All 6 SERP endpoints working with AI fallback (no API keys configured). Existing routes unaffected.

SERP Status Endpoint.details: Returns all 3 providers with configured=false, available=false, 5 capabilities each, fallback_available=true

SERP Validate Keywords.details: AI fallback returns source=ai_estimate, fallback=true, keywords with search_volume, cpc, difficulty, intent

SERP Ranking Opportunities.details: AI fallback returns opportunities list with source=ai_estimate, fallback=true

SERP Competitor Gap.details: AI fallback returns gaps list with source=ai_estimate, fallback=true

SERP Longtail Discovery.details: AI fallback returns keywords list with source=ai_estimate, fallback=true

SERP Difficulty Analysis.details: AI fallback returns difficulties list with difficulty_score, difficulty_label

Provider Abstraction.details: All 3 providers (ahrefs, semrush, dataforseo) implement same 5 capabilities: keyword_validation, ranking_opportunities, competitor_gap, longtail_discovery, serp_difficulty

Environment Variables.details: AHREFS_API_KEY, SEMRUSH_API_KEY, DATAFORSEO_LOGIN, DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD present in backend/.env (empty values - AI fallback used)

serp_architecture.ai_fallback: enabled when no provider API keys configured

mocked_apis.note: SERP providers have no API keys - AI fallback via Emergent LLM key is used. This is design behavior, not mocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: GG2026 Phase 4 SERP Intelligence layer complete. 3 providers (Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO) abstracted via BaseSERPProvider interface. 6 new endpoints under /api/agents/serp/*. SERPManager in manager.py auto-selects provider or falls back to AI. Provider switching possible by adding API keys to .env without code changes. LLM fallback calls take 5-20s.
